callouts.label: Name the Goal
callouts.hint: The cyclist beginning beside the compass mosaic at far left.
callouts.description: A clear goal gives decisions a direction.
callouts.ap_tip: Goals can change as a person learns more.

callouts.label: Notice Influences
callouts.hint: The family, peers, media, and mentor thought bubbles across the upper-left ridge.
callouts.description: Family, peers, culture, media, emotions, and access can shape a choice.
callouts.ap_tip: Influence is information, not automatic control.

callouts.label: Compare Options
callouts.hint: The cluster of riders choosing among several paths.
callouts.description: List more than one realistic option before deciding.
callouts.ap_tip: A strong option should fit safety, values, resources, and the goal.

callouts.label: Short-Term Consequences
callouts.hint: The nearby fork where riders meet immediate terrain changes.
callouts.description: Short-term consequences happen soon after a choice.
callouts.ap_tip: Convenience, feelings, cost, and immediate safety can all matter.

callouts.label: Long-Term Consequences
callouts.hint: The rider pausing at the wide valley overlook.
callouts.description: Long-term consequences may affect future health, relationships, habits, or opportunities.
callouts.ap_tip: Uncertainty should be acknowledged rather than hidden.

callouts.label: Use Support
callouts.hint: The accessible rest shelter with peers in the center.
callouts.description: Trusted people and resources can improve a decision.
callouts.ap_tip: Seeking support is part of ownership, not surrendering it.

callouts.label: Reflect Honestly
callouts.hint: The cyclist beside the reflective pond at lower left.
callouts.description: Reflection asks what happened, what helped, and what needs adjustment.
callouts.ap_tip: The purpose is learning, not shame.

callouts.label: Change Course
callouts.hint: The rider using the central switchback trail.
callouts.description: A new route can be chosen when evidence or circumstances change.
callouts.ap_tip: Course correction is a health skill, not failure.

callouts.label: Own the Next Step
callouts.hint: The inclusive group celebrating near the lower-right compass.
callouts.description: Ownership means choosing the next realistic action and tracking it.
